description: NaSm₃GeS₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent S atoms to form face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.72 Å) and three longer (2.76 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Sm-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.26 Å. Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.21 Å) and three longer (2.25 Å) Ge-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent Sm and one Ge atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Sm atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Sm and one Ge atom.
